summary: Core requested login-page replacement appears implemented: a new /login route renders a LoginPage using the existing Internet Identity hook; /my-submissions now renders the LoginPage; the header no longer shows “My Submissions”; and the post-submit CTA now navigates to /login. However, the diff also includes multiple unrelated UI/theme/admin/error-handling changes not requested in the BuildRequest.

hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest only asks to replace/remove My Submissions with a dedicated Login page and update related navigation/links; it does not request changes to the stories feed behavior.

hallucinated_features.description: Unrelated enhancements to StoryDetailPage (not-found handling, navigation back to feed)
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested as part of replacing/removing My Submissions or adding a login page.

hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested; scope explicitly limited to login/logout UI and removing/redirecting My Submissions.

hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested; BuildRequest does not mention updating access denied UI.
